cues: The generative cell divides once more to give two male gametes.
In about sixty percent of families that happens later, inside the pollen tube; in grasses, mustards and sunflowers it happens before the pollen is shed, so the grain is shed three celled.
Either way, the whole male gametophyte is just three cells.
